tex_content.html:
If $l_x^{\mathrm{min}}(\tau )$ denotes the minimum of $l_x$ on $U_{T-\tau }$, then $l_x^{\mathrm{min}}(\tau )\leq 3/2$ throughout the interval on which all preceding reduced lengths are at most $L/2$.
Proof

\sketch ↗ cor:minimizing-geodesic-to-earlier-slice ↗ prop:minimizing-L-geodesics-exist ↗ cor:generalized-flow-n-half-bound Apply Corollary compactcoro using the already established existence, nonemptiness, and compactness properties of $U$.

□
